name: fers-calculations
summary: The FERS structural analysis (FEM) engine: 3D frames, trusses and plates; second-order P-Delta, modal, buckling and response-spectrum analysis; Eurocode 3 (EN 1993-1-1) member checks with lateral-torsional buckling. JSON in, results out. For the Python SDK, pip install FERS.
